Hi,

I have over 24 years of experience in global product sourcing and procurement, including nearly 20 years working in China. I have excellent contacts with direct manufacturers across Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Dongguan, Yiwu and other major manufacturing hubs. I can also speak Mandarin, which helps me communicate directly with factories and negotiate better prices and terms.

Around 90% of my clients' products are sourced and shipped directly from China, so I have strong experience handling the complete sourcing process.

I can take care of everything from identifying genuine manufacturers, comparing quotations, negotiating prices and MOQs, arranging samples, following up on production, conducting QC inspections and coordinating shipments.

My focus is always on finding reliable manufacturers, competitive pricing and consistent product quality rather than simply choosing the cheapest supplier.

I'm interested in building a long-term working relationship and can handle ongoing sourcing requirements with regular updates and transparent communication.

Let's discuss your requirements. I'm confident I can be a valuable sourcing partner for your business.

Best regards,
Surendra Sharma

You get a clear English comparison sheet with my recommendation. I negotiate in Chinese, coordinate samples and consolidation, request photo/video QC evidence, and arrange an independent inspection (QIMA or V-Trust) when needed. Updates every 1-2 days; my company can issue invoices. Which product should I source first?

SANTA ANA CA IMPORTER ALERT — 2026 US TARIFF & CBP 40% TRANSSHIPMENT SHIELD VIA GENUINE VIETNAM OEM SOURCING

Before locking 100% into mainland China: shipping China-origin SKUs into LA/Long Beach (35m from Santa Ana) triggers stacked 2026 Section 301 + IEEPA duties (45%-70%+) with zero De Minimis relief, while simple third-country rerouting triggers US CBP 40% transshipment penalties (19 USC 1592).

Based on the ground in Vietnam's HCMC-Binh Duong factory belt with EN-ZH-VI trilingual spec negotiation (including Mandarin-run FDI plants relocated from Shenzhen/Jiangsu), I transition US importers from China SKUs to genuine 20%-tier Vietnam OEM factories:

1. China-vs-Vietnam Landed-Cost Matrix: Match your photos/1688 links across 3-5 vetted Vietnam factories (FOB, MOQ, lead time & HTSUS duty savings into USLGB/USLAX).
2. CBP Substantial-Transformation Shield: Audit factory ERC/IRC licenses, local BOM value-add, live line video & VCCI Certificate of Origin Form B (0% transshipment risk).
3. Samples & Pre-Shipment QC: Consolidate counter-samples + run on-site ISO 2859-1 Level II AQL 2.5 QC (Lot N=1,200 -> Code J n=80, Ac=5/Re=6) pre-loading at Cai Mep (16-19d to LA).

Pilot: 20h Sprint at USD 22/hr (Funded M1 Gate). Send 1-2 SKU photos/links to benchmark!

We're looking for an experienced sourcing agent based in China to help us find products directly from manufacturers.

We'll provide product photos or links, and you'll be responsible for:

- Finding reliable manufacturers offering the same or equivalent products.
- Obtaining competitive pricing, MOQs, and production lead times.
- Negotiating the best possible prices, moq and terms.
- Comparing quotations from multiple factories.
- Arranging samples when needed.
- Conducting quality control (QC) inspections before shipment.
- Coordinating with suppliers and providing regular updates.

**Requirements:**
- Based in mainland China and fluent in Chinese.
- Experience sourcing directly from factories
- Strong negotiation skills and experience with quality inspections.
- Able to communicate in English.

We're looking for someone reliable for ongoing product sourcing.
